column1: # App names of BBOS 7 outside Bold7 (Settings > Apps, share sheet, permission dialogs, recents,
# notification headers): one static RRO per app, generated from this table by build.gradle.kts and
# mounted in /system_ext/overlay by system/module. Tab-separated: id (RRO suffix and file name, one
# per app, a line per string), target package, name of the string resource that holds the label in
# the app (aapt2 dump xmltree of AndroidManifest.xml then aapt2 dump resources of the APKs of the
# Q25), BBOS 7 name. The names are those of core/icons/src/main/res/raw/bbos7_apps.tsv,
# so their sources are its own.
# Every language the target translates the label in (names-locales.tsv, from tools/names_locales.py
# over the APKs of the Q25) gets the same BBOS 7 name, plus fr and fr-rFR: BBOS 7 keeps one name in
# every language. A language the target adds later (a Play language split) is not covered.
# Not here, on purpose:
# - Chrome (Browser) and the Play Store (BlackBerry App World): the label is string/
#   0_resource_name_obfuscated, nothing to target.
# - Maps, Calendar, Contacts, Clock, Phone, Calculator: Android's default value already is the
#   BBOS 7 name, a RRO would change nothing in en-US.
# - Gmail: keeps its own name, in the launcher too, as the 9900 named a mail
#   account's icon after the account (gsm 020, C); Messages is Bold7's own app.
# X (com.twitter.android, Play Store) keeps the 9900's Twitter name of the grid (bbos7_apps.tsv):
# its label is string/APP_NAME, "X" in its default value only.
# LineageOS 24: Recorder and Glimpse (Gallery) are renamed after the OS 7 app of their job;
# Aperture (Camera), Twelve (Music), Jelly (Browser), Etar (Calendar) and Files already carry that name
# in their own label, so no line.
# Google Messages, hidden from the grid behind Bold7's Messages, is named Text
# Messages outside the launcher, so that no second "Messages" shows (share sheet, recents,
# permission dialogs, its notifications' header, as the 9900's list of notifications names texts,
# BBOS7-VISUEL section 5); app_name and share_intent_label are the two strings that carry the label.
# This is the one line whose name is not that of bbos7_apps.tsv: the launcher has its own Text Messages icon (Bold7's Messages on its texts) and names Google
# Messages "Google Messages" there (Show All, the search, the app switcher); outside the launcher
# only Google Messages does texts, no doubling (D).
